name: Harness casts a ground-targeted Witch Doctor spell at the position of a unit
contract: ADR 1028 (provisional) adds destination_unit to cast: the cast sends that unit's current position as its
ground target. Splash Potion 802710 has Targets 64 (a destination) and Effect[0..2] TARGET_DEST_DEST (87) with
TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY, healing up to $i allies within EffectRadiusIndex 13 of the destination; it needs a
brewed Ingredient (Bloodthistle 801664, Cauldron Brewer 92085, the marker 801702 set as a fixture). Cast with
the dummy 3 yd away as destination_unit, it completes and heals the wounded doctor inside its radius. The step
record carries the sent destination (destination_x, destination_y).
